verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is a first-party CI/CD feature: workflows are written in YAML, the workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions, existing Actions can be reused, and an official action runner is provided (with Kubernetes autoscaling runners offered). That covers pipelines-as-code running natively in the product. The 2018 community remark that Gitea does not bundle CI predates Actions and is not a concrete hands-on failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of push and pull-request triggers and of where workflow files live in the repository, plus independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions running pipelines.
